<quote by="Announced by Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, Master of the Koboldi">To commission Dima's Light of Ossium, a great work on the Bittershore, costing 40 white granite, 10 mithril, 5 ilium, and 150 crowns. Fully self-funded. Many thanks to King-under-the-Mountain and his dependable forekoboldi Drageer for this boon.

==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in Bittershore, Ossium
* Announcement by '''Dima Vasilyevna Novosad''', [[Master of the Koboldi]]
* The [[Is_there_anybody_out_there%3F#Beacon_in_Ossium|plans]] for the grand beacon were first presented by one of the  ''koboldi'' shortly before the Spring Equinox 387YE

==Date==
* Autumn 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 40 wains of white granite
* 10 wains of mithril
* 5 rings of ilium
* 150 crowns in labour costs 
* Six months to construct

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Dima%27s_Light_of_Ossium}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, Dima's Light of Ossium will have the following effects:
* Warns of threats against Kostjyas Respite
* Establishes a beacon in Bittershore, increasing investment of fleets in Ossium by one
** Any fleet in Ossium undertaking a [[Fleet#Trading|trading]] action does so with a bonus rank
